requirements.text: Do not contact other bank employees about the competition
Tender in English, submitted through the portal before the deadline (22 Jan 2027 12:00 CET)
Valid ISO/IEC 27001 certification
At least two Nordic/EU/EEA bank references within five years
Deposit accounts: current, savings, fixed-term
Interest and fees per bank rules, incl. tiered rates
Publish account events as event streams
Parallel run with the current core system and daily balance reconciliation
Documented REST APIs with OpenAPI specification
PSD2 consent-based access and payment initiation, Berlin Group NextGenPSD2
Log all API calls (time, caller, consent ref), keep at least five years
Common, documented data model
Measure and report data quality
Full data lineage from source system to report
Per AI function: data used, explanation, human review points
No automated decisions about customers without human review
Data stored and processed in EU/EEA, incl. backups and support access
Notify serious ICT incidents within four hours
Take part in resilience testing incl. TLPT
Documented exit plan
Availability 99.95 % per month for customer-facing services
Planned maintenance 01:00–05:00, announced 14 days ahead
Support in English and Norwegian, 24/7 for critical incidents
Migration approach incl. test migrations, reconciliation, fallback

answers.answer: We confirm that we will only communicate with the bank through the tender portal during the competition.
The tender will be submitted through the tender portal in English before 29 January 2027.
Met. Nordlys holds an ISO/IEC 27001 certification covering development, hosting and operation of all Nordlys Accounts & Data services, valid until September 2028.
Met. Our references include a Norwegian savings bank, a Swedish savings bank and a Danish regional bank.
Met. The solution supports current accounts, savings accounts and fixed-term deposits for retail and business customers.
Met. The interest and fee engine is configured with rules set by the bank, including tiered and date-dependent rates.
Partly met. Account data can be delivered to other systems as nightly files.
Met. Our parallel-run toolkit reconciles balances between the current core system and Nordlys automatically every day.
Met. All services are available as REST APIs with OpenAPI 3 specifications.
Met. Access-to-account and payment initiation APIs follow the Berlin Group NextGenPSD2 standard and include consent management.
Met. A documented common data model for customers, accounts, products and transactions is delivered to the bank.
Met. Data quality dashboards measure completeness, accuracy and timeliness for each data product.
Met. The solution keeps full data lineage from every source system to the bank's reports.
Met. Each AI function comes with a documentation package describing purpose, data used, explanation method and human review points.

Met. The data quality assistant (in production) only suggests corrections that a person approves. The adviser insight summary is a pilot, with general availability planned for 2027, and makes no automated decisions.
Met. All customer data, backups and support access stay within the EU/EEA, with hosting in Norway and Finland.
Met. Serious ICT incidents are reported to the bank within 24 hours of detection.
Met. Nordlys takes part in customers' resilience testing, including TLPT.
Met. A standard exit plan and exit assistance are described in the service agreement.
Met. Our standard SLA guarantees 99.95 % availability per month.
Met. Planned maintenance is done between 01:00 and 05:00 and announced 14 days in advance.
Met. We offer 24/7 support in English and Norwegian.
Met. The migration toolkit supports test migrations, automatic reconciliation and rollback for each migration step.
